A Rift-touched carrion crawler — a segmented, many-tentacled horror that scavenges the battlefields and ruins of the Severed Lands. Its paralytic slime has been altered by Rift exposure to induce waking nightmares in its victims, who remain conscious but immobile as they are slowly consumed.
## Traits
**Keen Smell.** Advantage on Perception relying on smell.
**Spider Climb.** Climb difficult surfaces, including upside down.

## Actions
**Multiattack.** Two tentacle attacks or one bite + tentacles.
**Bite.** +4 to hit, 7 (2d4 + 2) piercing.
**Tentacles.** +8 to hit, reach 10 ft., 4 (1d4 + 2) poison. DC 13 CON save or poisoned for 1 minute and paralyzed while poisoned. Repeat save at end of each turn.
